full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant for the purpose of disposal of the Rule may be briefly stated as follows: On 01.04.2007 the petitioner Md. Hafiz Uddin lodged an ejhar with Gouripur Police Station, Mymenshing against the opposite-party Nos.2-14 and others on the allegations, inter alia, that on 31.03.2007 some members of the staff of Palli Biddut Samity had come to Baruamari village under Police Station Gouripur to disconnect some illegal electric connections and accordingly they disconnected the illegal electrio lines of the opposite party Nos.2-14 and others. For disconnection of the electric lines, the accused-party suspected the petitioner's elder brother Hatem Ali and his, cousin Shahidullah of having secret connivance; with the members of the staff of Palli -Biddut Samity. Because of this suspicion, there were hot altercations between the accused-party and the informant Party, Anyway, at one stage the accused-party variously assaulted the informant-party with Iethal weapons as a result of which two persons belonging to the informant-party succumbed to their injuries. After investigation, the police submitted charge-sheet against the accused-party under Sections , 143/323/324/325/326/307/302/ of the Penal Code. In due course the opposite-party Nos.2-14 and others were charged under, the relevant sections of the Penal Code. Subsequently, the case was transferred to the Druta Bichar Tribunal No.2, Dhaka, and the Tribunal examined 23(twenty three) witnesses out of 24(twenty four), charge-sheet named witness in support of the prosecution version of the case. But by the impugned order No.109 dated 01.02.2010 the ;Tribunal below, acquitted the opposite-party Nos.2-1 4 as., per, Section 494 of the Code of Criminal Procedure upon an application dated 24.2.2009 submitted by the Special Public Prosecutor referring to the ,Memo-: No স্বম/(আইন-১) মামালা প্রত্যাহার-১২/২০০৯(৯ম সভা)/১৫৩৪.dated 01.12.2009 issued by the Home Ministry Government of the People's Republic Of Bangladesh.
